# 1 Enoch Chapter 51 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 51:1 — "give back" triple formula — word choice

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "give-back-that-which-has-been-entrusted" / "give-back-that-which-it-has-received" / "give-back-that-which-it-owes" | Three distinct Ge'ez verbs/phrases for three distinct relationships |
| LOGOS | "give back what has been entrusted" / "give back what it has received" / "give back what it owes" | Same, more natural |
| PNEUMA | "give back everything that has been entrusted" / "give back all it has received" / "give back what it owes" | Adds "everything/all" for emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS rendering adopted. The three distinct phrases (entrusted/received/owes) must be preserved separately — they represent different modalities of the resurrection obligation. PNEUMA's added "everything/all" is fine rhetorically but unsupported.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 51:4 — "lighted up with joy" vs. "shine with joy"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "shall-be-lighted-up with-joy" | Literal; Ge'ez = to be illuminated |
| LOGOS | "shall be lighted up with joy" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "will shine with joy" | Natural English; active construction |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Shall be lighted up with joy" (LOGOS). The passive "lighted up" conveys that joy illuminates the angels from an external source (the resurrection), not merely their own internal joy.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 2**
